description: AI Campus Copilot chat interface, global UI polish (loading skeletons everywhere, toast notifications, empty states, error boundaries, 404 page, deep blue+teal theme finalization), and documentation. Depends on FEAT-003 (core frontend), FEAT-002 (AI backend endpoint). Independent of FEAT-004 and FEAT-005 in terms of files, but the polish step touches all pages — so this runs after those are stable.
steps: Create campus-x/frontend/src/pages/AICopilotPage.tsx: full-page chat interface. Layout: left sidebar showing conversation history (each session title = first message truncated to 40 chars). Main area: top = chat message list, bottom = input bar. Message bubbles: user messages right-aligned (accent background), bot messages left-aligned (white card with subtle shadow). Each bot message shows: text response + optional inline cards (for LOCATION_SEARCH → RoomDetailMiniCard, AVAILABILITY_SEARCH → AvailabilityResultMiniCard, RESOURCE_SEARCH → ResourceMiniCard). Typing indicator: animated 3-dot bounce while waiting for response. Send button + Enter key to submit. On empty state (no messages): show 6 suggestion chips: 'Where is the ladies restroom?', 'Find available classrooms now', 'CSE Sem 5 timetable', 'Download DBMS question papers', 'Show my complaints', 'Where is CSE-204?'. Clicking chip fills input and auto-submits. Accessible: role=log aria-live=polite on message list.

Create campus-x/frontend/src/components/chat/MessageBubble.tsx: renders user or bot message. Bot message: avatar (robot icon, accent color), text, optional cards rendered below text. User message: text only, user avatar initial.

Create campus-x/frontend/src/components/chat/InlineCards.tsx: renders different mini-card types based on response intent: RoomMiniCard (code, building, floor, status badge, type badge, capacity), ResourceMiniCard (title, subject, exam type, download count, Download button), ComplaintMiniCard (autoId, status, category, date). Each mini-card is compact (max 280px wide).
Create campus-x/frontend/src/components/chat/SuggestionChips.tsx: horizontal scrollable row of chip buttons. On click: fires the suggestion as a query.

Polish campus-x/frontend/src/index.css and Tailwind theme: finalize deep blue (primary-900=#1E3A5F as sidebar bg, primary-800 as topbar, primary-50 as page background) + teal accent (accent-500=#14B8A6 for primary actions, accent-400 for hover). Apply consistent spacing: all cards use p-6 rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-gray-100. All tables use divide-y divide-gray-100. All form inputs use consistent ring-accent-500 focus ring.

Audit all data-fetching pages from FEAT-004 and FEAT-005: add Skeleton loading states where missing. Pattern: while isLoading→ render SkeletonCard×N; while isError→ render EmptyState with error icon and retry button; while data?.length===0→ render EmptyState with context-appropriate message and action button. Pages to audit: FindClassroomPage, TimetablePage, ResourceSearchPage, ComplaintsPage, AnalyticsDashboard, BuildingManagement, RoomManagement, TimetableManagement, ComplaintManagement, MyUploadsPage, MyReservationsPage.

Wrap all page-level components with ErrorBoundary from shared UI library. Add to router: errorElement prop on each route pointing to an inline error boundary fallback that shows 'Something went wrong' + Reload button.

Add Toast context to campus-x/frontend/src/main.tsx (ToastProvider wrapping app). Audit all form submissions and mutations from FEAT-004 and FEAT-005: every POST/PATCH/DELETE must call useToast().success() on 2xx or useToast().error() on error. Toast appears bottom-right, stacks up to 5, auto-dismisses after 4s, has X close button.

Create campus-x/frontend/src/pages/NotFoundPage.tsx (update from FEAT-003 stub): styled 404 page with campus illustration (use Lucide Building2 icon large), '404 — Page Not Found' heading, 'The page you're looking for doesn't exist or has been moved.' text, Go Home button.

Create campus-x/frontend/src/pages/UnauthorizedPage.tsx (update from FEAT-003 stub): styled 403 page with ShieldX icon, 'Access Restricted' heading, 'You don't have permission to view this page.' text, role-appropriate Go Back link.

Create campus-x/docs/README.md: project overview, tech stack, setup instructions (prerequisites, .env config, Docker Compose start, seed command), role-based access summary, demo credentials table, all 7 demo scenario curl commands, architecture diagram (ASCII).
Create campus-x/docs/API.md: all API endpoints listed with method, path, auth required, role restrictions, request body shape, response shape. One section per route group.
Run `cd campus-x/frontend && npm run build` — exits 0, no TS errors, no Tailwind warnings.
acceptance_criteria: Logged in as any role: /ai-copilot renders chat interface with 6 suggestion chips on empty state
Typing 'Where is the ladies restroom near CSE block?' and sending returns a bot response with room location data (not hallucinated)
Typing 'Find available classrooms now' returns a list of available rooms as mini-cards
All pages show skeleton loading placeholders during data fetch (not blank white screens)
All form submissions show success toast on success and error toast on API error
403 page shows when a student tries to access /admin/analytics
Primary color is deep blue throughout sidebar/topbar; accent teal on buttons and active nav items
docs/README.md exists with setup instructions and demo credentials
verification: npm run dev, navigate /ai-copilot, send suggestion chip 'Where is the ladies restroom?', confirm bot response with room data
npm run dev, navigate /this-does-not-exist, confirm 404 page renders
